activityTimeVect:
Minimum required level of Void Region is Lv.100.
Void Region will be available on 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, 20th, 24th and 28th every month.
Attendants of Void Region will receive participating rewards.
Top 100 players on damage ranking list will receive ranking rewards.
Rewards for Void Region will be different each time, based on players' ranking, No.1 player will receive 10* corresponding reward, No.2 player will receive 9* corresponding reward, No.3 player will receive 8* corresponding reward, No.4 player will receive 7* corresponding reward, No.5 player will receive 6* corresponding reward, No.6-7 players will receive 5* corresponding reward, No.8-10 players will receive 4* corresponding reward and No.11-100 players will receive 2* corresponding reward.
